feature: Each part of a sound's volume line opens its own right-click menu
summary: Right-clicking a level point and then a segment on a sound's volume line now opens the segment's curve list, every time. Before, the segment showed the menu of whatever you had right-clicked last.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. Open the sample recording, add the sample music, set Fade in to 3.

try.do: Command-click the music's volume line three times to add three level points.
Right-click the third point: the menu offers Delete Point.
Right-click the segment just before it: the menu is the curve list with Linear ticked.
Right-click the fourth point, then right-click the first segment and choose Hold.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Right-click the third segment and choose Ease out, then right-click the first again: Hold is ticked there, not Ease out.

evaluate: Does every right-click on the line open the menu for the dot or segment under the pointer?
Does a curve you pick from a segment's menu always land on that segment?
Does the right-click pick the dot or segment it landed on, so you can see what the menu acts on?
rough: The level point where a fade ends sits under the clip's fade handle, so right-clicking it opens no menu at all; that was the same before this change and is logged on this task.
No mock covers the volume line's right-click menus; the rows are the shared curve list the value graph uses.
